Awful Falafel
Nov 2019
I have been hankering for a good falafel so thought I would give this place a try. Well that was huge mistake. It must have been the worst falafel I have ever had. How complicated is it? even I make better falafel and Tahini! 

Firstly if you want to ruin a perfectly healthy (and complete protein) meal add french fries! disgusting! and they had taken the flavour of the very old and overused oil. There was no spicy sauce (only Vietnamese brand tuong ot - chilli sauce - which is WRONG on so many levels). The chick peas themselves had little flavour, Asked for extra tahini - (which took 10 min to get) was watery and lacked the richness i have come to know and love about tahini. such a disappointment! will have to venture to the other places to check out the offerings. 

If you want a good falafel - DON'T COME HERE!

Disgraceful meal
Nov 2019
Do not go here! I ordered butter chicken and got mostly bone with it. I explained the situation, told her I was unhappy, and showed the waitress that there’s more bone in my meal than the chicken meat, she tells me the butter chicken comes with the bone and that’s why the meal is cheap, I should have ordered the boneless butter chicken. WTAF! Well for your information, your menu should have made it clear to customers they are getting bones in their food, I would have selected boneless, and secondly, it wasn’t cheap for your butter chicken! This has got to be the worse and only restaurant in Vietnam that deceives / cheats customers and sells butter chicken with bone! I did get a discount, in fact you should have not charged me at all. The meal, customer service was poor quality.

Value for monet
Jun 2019 • Business
This unpretentious hidden gem tucked not far away from bui vien and ben tanh market in saigon city centre has been around for years, serving good, affordable menu sets to groups of hungry diners. Their long list of food ensures that your group has an ample array to choose from, such as combo meals set . Lunch set . Etc...! Middle eastern and indian food full menu
This space is comfortable to sit at for hours while you catch up with your friends over a cup of tea or shisha . 
Seatings upstsirs feels like home with sofa and wifi iptv can watch international tv stations and sport events 
And same at back door on ho chi minh backpackers street have seating where you can have shisha or smoking while eating and watching international sports matches .. as no smoking allowed in main hall .
